item.title: Vehicle Restrictions to Take Effect on Interstates, Turnpike During Winter Storm
item.description: PennDOT has announced that Tier 4 vehicle restrictions will go into effect beginning 12:01 a.m. Sunday, January 25, as a major winter storm is expected to impact central Pennsylvania. The restrictions will apply to all Pennsylvania interstates, the Pennsylvania Turnpike and its extensions, along with several other major roadways across the state. item.title: North Schuylkill Upsets Pottsville, 52-50, in Schuylkill League Division 1 Showdown
item.description: North Schuylkill pulled off a dramatic upset Friday night, defeating visiting Pottsville 52-50 in a Schuylkill League Division 1 matchup that came down to the final seconds. Entering the game, Pottsville sat second in the league standings at 9-1 and was looking to rebound from its first league loss earlier in the week to Minersville. item.title: All Fine Wine & Good Spirits Stores in Pennsylvania to Close Sunday Due to Winter Storm
item.description: The Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board (PLCB) announced that all Fine Wine & Good Spirits locations across the commonwealth will be closed on Sunday, January 25, due to the impending winter storm. The closure is being implemented to help ensure the safety of both customers and employees as hazardous weather conditions are expected throughout much of Pennsylvania.
